localizedValues.name: Y1
localizedValues.description: No tents or pets allowed in the yurt area. No smoking, no cooking in yurt. The yurts are situated in a wooded area of the park and are within walking distance of the Mount St. Helens Visitor Center. Each yurt is 16 feet in diameter by 10 feet high and furnished with a queen-size futon, a bunk bed that sleeps three, small end table and heater. Outside is a picnic table and fire pit with grate. All yurts are heated, but visitors should come prepared with blankets and warm clothing as evenings can be cooler. Restrooms and showers are nearby.
